newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Publicis in $250 mln buying spree - chairman.
newsitem.headline: Publicis in $250 mln buying spree - chairman.

text.p: The chairman of French advertising group Publicis SA said on Tuesday the company planned to spend US$250 million on acquisitions to turn itself into a global player in the media world.
"We have US$250 million to spend on acquisitions," Publicis chairman Maurice Levy told Reuters in an interview.
Levy, speaking after a news conference to announce taking a 60 percent controlling stake in Singapore advertising agency
